title: Finding
description: One review finding. Agents, scanners and the arbiter all use this shape.

rule.description: Doc ID or scanner rule ID. With resource_address it forms the deduplication key.

agent.description: Who reported it. scanner means no LLM agent did.

deterministic.description: True when a scanner (Checkov, conftest) found it, alone or as well as an agent. Code sets this, never a model. Only deterministic high findings can block.

evidence.description: Every finding needs a plan pointer, and a finding no scanner backs also needs a doc ID. The evidence check then drops findings whose pointer doesn't resolve or whose doc isn't accepted.

plan_pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the condensed plan, keyed by resource address, which stays stable across slices and re-pushes. Escape / as ~1 and ~ as ~0 in the address.
